name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Clean UI & Diagnostics release: streamlined header (removed stale version badge & top daemon badge), renamed tab to simple «Magnet», fixed missing I18N key causing «undefined» on trackers header, added interactive connection test buttons with live status badges for both TorrServer and Prowlarr in Settings.
